senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. בָּקַר) morning, early day; metaph. light, salvation.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:1:17">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵃ</cite> top <he>ב׳ לצדיקים וכ׳</he> a morning for the righteous, a night for the wicked. Ruth. R. to III, 13 <he>בַּבּ׳ בעולם וכ׳</he> ‘in the morning’—that means in the world which is all-good. Esth. R., introd. (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 28:67">Deut. XXVIII, 67</cite>) <he>בבָקְרָהּ של בבל וכ׳</he> in the morning (ascendancy) of Babel thou shalt say, Oh that her evening (downfall) would come! <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 21:1">Gen. R. s. 21</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Daniel 8:14">Dan. VIII, 14</cite>) <he>לִכְשֶׁיֵּעָשֶׂה בָּקְרָן וכ׳</he> when the morning of the (persecuting) nations shall become evening, and the evening of Israel morning; Tanḥ. ed. Bub.

<cite ref="Genesis 23">B’resh. 23</cite>. Mekh. Bo, s. 6 in order to define it: <he>לבָקְרוֹ של ב׳</he> at the very break of morning; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:16">Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ</cite> top.—Pl. <cite ref="B01396"><he>בְּקָרִים</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 33b:8">Yoma 33ᵇ</cite> <he>חלקהו לשני ב׳</he> divide the acts prescribed into two mornings, i.e. let another act be inserted between.
<cite ref="Berakhot 27a:11">Ber. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>חלקהו לשני ב׳</he> take only one half of the morning hours.
Y. Pes. V, 31ᵈ top אית לך מימר תמן בין הַבְּקָרַיִם then it ought to have read there ben hab-b’karaim (as you read בין הערבים, Du.).
